notes.title: Bug Fix, Balancing and Cheat mode for children
notes.notes:
- Balancing for high level monsters
- Fix small bugs during combat
- Added Children mode with a cheat that gives you infinite gold and you can't die (not suggested for normal players 6+). Press 106 at the start menu to activate!
